definitions: A protocol used by the World Wide Web that defines how messages are formatted and transmitted, and what actions Web servers and browsers should take in response to various commands.
The underlying protocol used by the World Wide Web to define how messages are formatted and transmitted between web servers and clients.
examples: HTTP is the foundation of data communication for the World Wide Web.
Most websites use Hypertext Transfer Protocol.
Secure Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTPS) adds encryption.
